headline: Gold Prices Eased Near $4,010 Ahead of Federal Reserve Rate Decision
summary: Gold prices slipped to around $4,010 per ounce as market participants awaited the Federal Reserve's policy statement and monitored diplomatic developments in the Middle East.
why: Gold is a primary non-yielding safe-haven asset whose price reflects global geopolitical risk and expectations for US interest rates.

impacts.name: Gold Futures
impacts.why: Pre-meeting positioning ahead of the Federal Reserve policy announcement weighed on gold prices.

why_moved: Expectations surrounding the Federal Reserve rate path and Middle East diplomatic progress reduced near-term safe-haven demand.
